official_crop_production_india.name: District-Wise Crop Production Statistics of India
official_crop_production_india.organization: Directorate of Economics and Statistics (DES), Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
official_crop_production_india.geographic_coverage: 33 Indian States / Union Territories, 646 Agricultural Districts
official_crop_production_india.crops_coverage: 124 crops recorded; 20 Terra target crops extracted and standardized (19 with non-zero historical production, 1 watermelon recorded with 0.0 production)

raw_to_clean_audit.rounding_boundary_note: 122,427 rows retained with 2-decimal rounded boundary filtering (122,418 if using unrounded 64-bit float math, a 9-row difference at exact physiological boundary thresholds).

transformations_applied: Mapped 20 official crop names to canonical Terra crop IDs (e.g. Gram -> chickpea, Moong -> mungbean)
Normalized seasons: Summer -> Zaid, Winter/Autumn -> Rabi/Kharif
Dropped rows with missing Production (1,297 rows in Terra crops; NO imputation)
Dropped non-positive Production rows (562 rows; NO imputation)
Filtered Area < 1.0 ha smallholder anomalies (22 rows, 6 with positive production)
Applied ICAR physiological yield boundaries to remove transcription errors (1,535 rows filtered; >98.8% retention)

adequacy_for_ml_evaluation.regional_yield_benchmarking: EXCELLENT — provides real empirical yield distributions (median, IQR, 10th-90th percentiles) across 646 districts over 18 years for 19 crops.
adequacy_for_ml_evaluation.farm_level_predictive_limitation: CANNOT VALIDATE FARM-LEVEL NPK/WEATHER PREDICTOR — District statistics reflect macro regional aggregates (total production / total cropped area) and lack field-level NPK soil test chemistry, irrigation volumes, and plot management practices. Claiming district data validates farm-level predictive accuracy commits the ecological fallacy.

crop_suitability_real.name: Crop Recommendation Dataset (Augmented Precision Agriculture Benchmark)
crop_suitability_real.author: Atharva Ingle
crop_suitability_real.organization: Kaggle Dataset Creator (atharvaingle/crop-recommendation-dataset); mirrored in Harvestify Project
crop_suitability_real.license: Public Domain / Open Access (MIT on repository mirror)
crop_suitability_real.collection_method: Built by augmenting Indian rainfall, climate, and fertilizer datasets around optimal crop conditions.
crop_suitability_real.data_nature: AUGMENTED / SYNTHETIC benchmark. NOT raw uncurated ICAR field plot telemetry or physical IoT sensor feeds.
crop_suitability_real.geographic_coverage: Synthetic parameter augmentation based on Indian agro-climatic conditions
crop_suitability_real.crops_coverage: 22 crops (100 observations each, total 2,200 rows; 8 directly match Terra catalog: rice, maize, chickpea, pigeonpea, mungbean, lentil, cotton, watermelon)
crop_suitability_real.data_quality: Clean benchmark: 0 null values, 0 duplicate rows, 100 balanced samples per crop, Gaussian-like clusters around distinct centers.

adequacy_for_ml_evaluation.benchmark_classification: Measures classifier ability to separate 22 distinct augmented crop clusters (achieves 99.64% 5-fold CV).
adequacy_for_ml_evaluation.real_world_generalization_limitation: DOES NOT ESTABLISH REAL-FARM FIELD ACCURACY. Because clusters are synthetically augmented and well-separated in 7D space, high CV accuracy is an in-distribution property. When tested against models trained on unaugmented crop ideals, cross-domain accuracy drops to ~23.5%. It does not prove real-world accuracy on actual messy farm soil tests.

nasa_power_agroclimatology.name: NASA Prediction of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER) Agroclimatology API v2.6
nasa_power_agroclimatology.organization: NASA Langley Research Center / POWER Project
nasa_power_agroclimatology.license: NASA Open Data Policy (CC0 / Public Domain)
nasa_power_agroclimatology.access_type: Free / Public / Programmatic REST API (No API key required)
nasa_power_agroclimatology.date_coverage: 1981 – 2022 (42-year climatology baseline) and 2010 – 2015 historical time series
nasa_power_agroclimatology.geographic_coverage: 8 key Indian agro-ecological districts (Nashik, Ludhiana, Pune, Thanjavur, Varanasi, Rajkot, Indore, Guntur)

parameters_and_units.ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN: All Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance (MJ/m²/day)

nasa_power_agroclimatology.data_quality: Continuous assimilation model (MERRA-2) ground-referenced for agricultural meteorology, zero missing values.

adequacy_for_ml_evaluation.weather_feature_validation: EXCELLENT — provides real historical and seasonal temperature, precipitation, and humidity for validating regional weather assumptions.

cacp_price_cost_benchmarks.name: Official Minimum Support Prices (MSP) & Cost of Cultivation Surveys 2024-25
cacp_price_cost_benchmarks.organization: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP), Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI

units.Cost A2+FL: ₹ per Acre (derived from CACP survey per-hectare cost)

cacp_price_cost_benchmarks.adequacy_for_ml_evaluation: EXCELLENT — real economic baseline for validating optimizer revenue and cultivation cost models.

integrity_rules_enforced: Real records and synthetic records are stored separately and tagged with is_synthetic: False vs True.
Missing values in government statistics are dropped rather than imputed or fabricated.
Units are explicitly documented on both raw ingestion and processed outputs.
No credentials or paid APIs are used.
Regional district aggregate benchmarking is strictly decoupled from farm-level predictive validation.
